title: components, app-shell: 17 EmptyState implementations, 23 Skeletons and 5 error-boundary classes; the shared DataErrorState has one importer and ViewSkeleton none — make the shared vocabulary the only one
body:
Filing gate ③: a maintainer-directed task. Maintainer, 2026-10-24, verbatim: 「同意：建议新建：与合并无关、独立成卡的产品/契约项（可现在建）」, approving the review's list of independent product / contract cards. Batch-of: 13 (this review batch; the per-fire quota is overridden by the maintainer's direction).

## 维护者速读

空态/错误态/加载态各自为政：17 个 `*EmptyState`（app-shell 9）、23 个 `*Skeleton`、5 个错误边界类；共享的 `DataErrorState` 只有 1 个导入者，`ViewSkeleton` / `ShimmerSkeleton` 导出后 0 导入者；`Loader2` 旋转器 155 处 vs `Skeleton` 108 处；`toast.error` 154 处（19 处英文字面量）；`role="alert"` 68 处对 372 处 `text-destructive`——行内错误大多不向辅助技术播报。建议把 `DataEmptyState` / `DataErrorState` / `view-skeleton` 定为列表/详情/仪表盘面的唯一呈现，并与开卡 objectstack-ai/objectui#13386 / objectstack-ai/objectui#12618（全空分区怎么画）一起落到共享组件上。

## Measured (2026-10-24, HEAD 7981384; script `errstate.mjs` in the review scratchpad)

- Definitions: `*EmptyState` 17 across 5 packages (app-shell 9 — `AppNoAccessEmptyState`, `agentEmptyState`, `PreviewDraftEmptyState`, `InspectorEmptyState`, `PreviewEmptyState`, `StudioEmptyState` and more; components 3 including `DataEmptyState`, `EmptyStateLink`, `BuiltinSelectEmptyState`; fields `OptionsEmptyState`; chatbot `ConversationEmptyState`; plugin-detail `BoundRecordEmptyState`); `*ErrorState` 1; `*Skeleton` 23.
- Adoption of the shared vocabulary (`packages/components/src/custom/view-states.tsx`, `view-skeleton.tsx`): `DataEmptyState` 8 importers, `DataErrorState` 1, `EmptyStateLink` 2, `ViewSkeleton` 0, `ShimmerSkeleton` 0 (both exported from `custom/index.ts`).
- Ad hoc: `Loader2` spinners 155 vs `Skeleton` 108; inline "No data / results / records / items" literals 55; "Something went wrong" 10; `toast.error(` 154 (19 with an English literal, 47 with `t(`); `console.error(` 80 in UI packages.
- Error boundaries: `SchemaErrorBoundary` (in `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx`, used by 10 files), `packages/app-shell/src/chrome/ErrorBoundary.tsx`, `PreviewErrorBoundary`, `packages/react-runtime/src/index.tsx`, `packages/react/src/LazyPluginLoader.tsx`.
- Business reason: the same "nothing here" or "this failed" reads differently on every surface, and most inline errors are silent for assistive technology; NORTH-STAR "同一套设计系统、同一种版式".
- Dedup (`DataEmptyState|DataErrorState|EmptyState|ViewSkeleton|role="alert"`): 35 hits, 0 open about the systemic shape; open and adjacent: objectui#13386 / objectui#12618 (empty-section presentation decision); closed: objectstack-ai/objectui#13142, objectstack-ai/objectui#13356, objectstack-ai/objectui#13207, objectstack-ai/objectui#12889.

## Task

- [ ] Declare `DataEmptyState` / `DataErrorState` / the `view-skeleton` family the only presentations for list, detail and dashboard surfaces; give `DataErrorState` `role="alert"` by construction.
- [ ] Migrate app-shell's 9 EmptyState variants to `DataEmptyState` props (icon / title / description / action); route renderer `catch` paths to `DataErrorState`.
- [ ] Delete `ShimmerSkeleton` / `ViewSkeleton` if still unused after the migration; land the objectui#13386 decision on the shared component.

Who acts: objectui `domain:ui` seat, one PR per package. Effort M. Risk: visual diffs in the console; rollback per file.

Filed by the read-only whole-repo review session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01BDtwYUWhLGyWLzYQjZ95Cf` on 2026-10-24, written through the maintainer's own account token (the session holds no fleet-bot credential). Evidence files: that session's scratchpad (`objectui-review-report.md`, `findings-*.md`). ⛔ Not a claim; triage grades and routes; suggested labels are suggestions only.
